title: Irish Cheese Casserole
description: A classic, comforting Irish-inspired cheese casserole perfect for a cozy night in. This dish combines the creaminess of cheese with the heartiness of authentic Irish ingredients.
instructions: Cook the sausages in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the casserole mix to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a separate saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the milk and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add the cooked sausage mixture to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and hot through.
